policy.selection: First consecutive season pair satisfying count/night requirements, using timestamps and format only. All observations in each chosen season; no residual clipping.
policy.error_model: Independent reported per-exposure ADES covariance plus a zero-mean common two-dimensional station/UTC-night offset with fixed 0.15 arcsec standard deviation. Illustrative sensitivity model, not an externally calibrated survey error model.
policy.comparison: Independent-error baseline and fixed correlated-night model; both trained on the same early season. Preserve every declared case, including failures. Holdout never chooses a model or error parameter.

fit.uncertainty_scope: Local linear covariance conditional on fixed physical/error model; inflated for excess scatter. Station-night common offsets included only at explicitly specified sigma. Global catalog/planet biases and uniqueness are not guaranteed.

holdout_uncertainty.scope: Local linear conditional 1-sigma axes of prediction alone; excluding future measurement noise, global catalog biases and background/model errors.

holdout_coverage.scope: Descriptive conditional coverage; model/background/global catalog errors omitted. Pointwise exposures are not independent; nights share fitted orbit uncertainty.

independent.separation: Initial hypotheses, optimization, multistart selection and covariance use training only. No clipping; every fixed holdout measurement is evaluated.
independent.limitation: Angular prediction experiment for one massless target with externally prescribed JPL observer/perturbers; not independent astronomical measurements or a fit of the whole Solar System.

scope: Measured-astrometry prediction of whole withheld seasons for a small declared sample. JPL observers/background remain prescribed. Fixed station-night sigma is a sensitivity assumption, not a calibrated instrument model.
